rules.title: Rent control at October 1, 1985 base rent; 30-day written notice of increases
rules.requirement: Rents in covered dwellings are controlled at the base rent received as of October 1, 1985, and no increases may be demanded, paid or accepted except as the chapter provides. Increases above those allowed are void and excess must be refunded or credited. A landlord seeking an increase must give written notice at least 30 days before the effective date, explaining the reason in detail.

rules.title: Annual increase cap: lesser of 5% or CPI change
rules.requirement: At lease expiration or termination of a periodic lease, a landlord may not request or receive an increase greater than 5% or the CPI percentage change, whichever is less. Only one such cost-of-living increase is allowed in any twelve-month period regardless of the number of tenants.

rules.quoted_span: At the expiration of a lease or at the termination of a lease of a periodic tenant, no landlord may request or receive a percentage increase in rent which is greater than 5% or the percentage difference between the consumer price index three months prior to the expiration or termination of the lease and three months prior to the commencement of the lease term, whichever is less.

rules.title: Rent increases only at lease expiration/termination; excess increases void
rules.requirement: Rents in covered dwellings are set under the chapter. Any rent increase at a time other than at lease expiration or termination of a periodic lease is void, as is any increase exceeding that authorized by the chapter.

rules.title: Capital improvement surcharge requires Board approval; 33 1/3% cap
rules.requirement: A landlord may not impose a capital improvement rent surcharge without prior Board approval. The cost is prorated over the improvement's useful life, and base rents may not increase by more than 33 1/3% due to a capital improvement surcharge in any twelve-month period.

rules.title: Municipal tax surcharge
rules.requirement: A landlord may seek a tax surcharge for municipal property tax increases above those assessed for the acquisition year or 1988, whichever is later. It is determined by the Rent Regulation Officer, paid in 12 equal monthly payments, lasts 12 months, must be reapplied for, may be imposed only at lease commencement/renewal, and the unit must be registered.

rules.title: Water and sewerage surcharge
rules.requirement: A landlord may seek a surcharge for municipal water and sewer charge increases over those assessed for 1996, determined by the Rent Regulation Officer, paid in 12 equal monthly installments and not counted as rent for computing cost-of-living increases.

rules.title: Hardship rent increase requires Board approval
rules.requirement: A landlord who cannot meet operating expenses or earn a fair return may appeal to the Board for a hardship increase. No increase under this Article may be imposed without prior Board approval, and the landlord must serve tenants notice at least 20 days before the hearing.
